<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|12|THE GOSPEL|CHA. V.}}</noinclude>{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Mr. 4, 21. Lu. 8, 16. 11, 33.''}}* candel and put it vnder a bushel, but vpon a candlesticke, that it may shine to al that are in the house. {{verse|chapter=5|verse=17}}† So let ‖ your light shine before men: that they may see your good workes, and glorifie your father vvhich is in heauen.

{{verse|chapter=5|verse=18}}† Do not thinke that I am come to breake the Lavv or the Prophets. I am not come to breake: but to fulfil. {{verse|chapter=5|verse=19}}† For assuredly I say vnto you, {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Luc. 16, 17.''}}* til heauen and earth passe, one iote or one tittle shal not passe of the Lavv: til al be fulfilled. {{verse|chapter=5|verse=20}}† He therfore that shal {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Ia. 2, 10.''}}* breake ‖ one of these least commaundementes, & shal so teach men: shal be called the least in the Kingdom of heauen. But he that shal doe and teach: he shal be called great in the Kingdom of heauen.⊣ {{verse|chapter=5|verse=21}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel vpō the fifth Sunday after Pentecost.}}For I tel you, that vnles ‖ your iustice abound more then that of the Scribes and Pharisees, you shal not enter into the Kingdom of heauen.

{{verse|chapter=5|verse=22}}† You haue heard that it vvas sayd to them of old. {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Exo. 20, 13. Deut. 5, 17.''}}* Thou shalt not kil. and vvho so killeth, shal be in danger of iudgement. {{verse|chapter=5|verse=23}}† But I say to you, that vvhosoeuer is angrie vvith his brother, shal be in danger of iudgment. And vvhosoeuer shal say to his brother, Raca: shal be in danger of a councel. And whosoeuer shal say, Thou foole: shal be guilty of the ‖ hel of fyre. {{verse|chapter=5|verse=24}}† If therefore thou offer thy ‖ gift at the altar, and there thou remember that thy brother hath ought agaynst the: {{verse|chapter=5|verse=25}}† leaue there thy offering before the altar, and goe first to be reconciled to thy brother: and then coming thou shalt offer thy gift.⊣ {{verse|chapter=5|verse=26}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Luc. 12, 58.''}}* Be at agreement vvith thy aduersarie betimes vvhiles thou art in the vvay vvith him: lest perhaps the aduersarie deliuer thee to the iudge, and the iudge deliuer thee to the officer, and thou be cast into {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ This Prison is taken of very ancient fathers, for Purgatorie: namely ''S. Cypr. ep. 52. ad Anton. nu. 6''.}}∷ prison. {{verse|chapter=5|verse=27}}† Amen I say to thee, thou shalt not goe out from thence til thou repay the last farthing.

{{verse|chapter=5|verse=28}}† You haue heard that it vvas sayd to them of old, {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Exo. 20, 14.''}}* Thou shalt not committe aduoutrie. {{verse|chapter=5|verse=29}}† But I say to you, that whosoeuer shal see a vvoman to lust after her, hath already committed aduoutrie vvith her in his hart. {{verse|chapter=5|verse=30}}† And if thy right eie scandalize thee, plucke it out, & cast it from thee. for it is expedient for thee that one of thy limmes perish, rather then thy vvhole body be cast into hel. {{verse|chapter=5|verse=31}}† And if thy right hand scandalize thee, cut it of, and cast it from thee: for it is expedient for thee that one of thy limmes perish, rather then that thy whole body goe into hel.

{{verse|chapter=5|verse=32}}† It vvas sayd also, {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Deut. 24, 1. Mt. 19, 7.''}}* vvhosoeuer shal dimisse his vvife, let<noinclude>{{rh|||him}}</noinclude>
